settings.title: Mipangilio
settings.noPermission: Ni wasimamizi pekee wanaoweza kufungua mipangilio.

branding.title: Chapa ya biashara
branding.intro: Jina, nembo, rangi na herufi zinazotumika kwenye tovuti, programu ya waandaaji na ukurasa wa malipo. Mabadiliko yanafika kwa kila mtu ndani ya dakika moja.
branding.noPermission: Ni wasimamizi pekee wanaoweza kubadilisha chapa.
branding.sourceDefault: Bado hakuna chapa iliyohifadhiwa; chapa chaguomsingi inatumika.
branding.taglineHint: Si lazima. Huonekana chini ya jina kwenye ukurasa wa malipo.

logo.title: Nembo
logo.hint: SVG (inapendekezwa), PNG, JPEG au WebP, hadi KB 200.
logo.svgNote: Faili za SVG hukaguliwa: hati, viungo vya nje na vishikio vya matukio vinakataliwa.
logo.removeBody: Nembo iliyojengwa ndani itatumika badala yake.

reasons.not_svg: Hii si faili sahihi ya SVG.
reasons.doctype: Matamko ya DOCTYPE na ENTITY hayaruhusiwi.
reasons.forbidden_element: Hati, kurasa zilizopachikwa na uhuishaji haviruhusiwi.
reasons.event_handler: Vishikio vya matukio kama onclick haviruhusiwi.
reasons.external_reference: SVG inaunganisha na kitu nje ya faili.
reasons.no_size: SVG inahitaji viewBox (au upana na urefu).
reasons.type_mismatch: Faili si aina ya picha inayodai kuwa.
reasons.bad_type: Nembo lazima iwe SVG, PNG, JPEG au WebP.

logo.builtin: Hakuna nembo uliyohifadhi bado, kwa hivyo nembo iliyojengwa ndani inatumika kila mahali. Pakia yako kuibadilisha.

colours.title: Rangi
colours.hint: Rangi kuu hutumika kwa vitufe na vichwa; maandishi juu yake huchaguliwa kiotomatiki (nyeupe au nyeusi).

fonts.title: Herufi
fonts.note: Herufi hizi tayari zipo kwenye simu ya mgeni, kwa hivyo hazipakuliwi wala kupunguza kasi.

importEnv.title: Hamisha kutoka mazingira ya seva
importEnv.body: Nakili funguo za SMS na WhatsApp zilizowekwa kwenye vigezo vya seva kuziweka hapa, zikiwa zimefichwa. Mipangilio uliyokwisha kuhifadhi haibadilishwi.
importEnv.nothing: Hakuna cha kuhamisha: kila njia imehifadhiwa tayari au haina mipangilio kwenye seva.
importEnv.after: Baada ya kuhamisha unaweza kufuta vigezo vya NEXTSMS_*, SMS_SENDER_ID na WHATSAPP_* kwenye seva; mipangilio iliyohifadhiwa itaendelea kufanya kazi.

paymentSettings.title: Malipo
paymentSettings.intro: Mtoa huduma wa malipo ya simu kwa michango ya wageni. Mabadiliko yanaanza kutumika mara moja, bila kuwasha upya seva.
paymentSettings.noPermission: Ni wasimamizi pekee wanaoweza kubadilisha mipangilio ya malipo.
paymentSettings.fakeWarning: Hakuna malipo halisi yatakayofanyika kwa mtoa huduma huyu. Wageni hawawezi kulipa kwa simu.

source.environment: Hakuna kilichohifadhiwa bado; vigezo vya seva vinatumika.

fieldHint.apiKey: Unaanza na snp_. Kutoka dashibodi ya Snippe.
fieldHint.webhookSigningKey: Unaonyeshwa mara moja Snippe inapounda webhook.
fieldHint.environment: Tumia sandbox kujaribu bila pesa halisi.
fieldHint.receiptEmail: Snippe inahitaji barua pepe ya mlipaji. Wageni hawaulizwi, kwa hivyo hii hutumika.

paymentSettings.resetBody: Mipangilio iliyohifadhiwa itafutwa. Seva itatumia vigezo vyake (majaribio) hadi uhifadhi tena.
paymentSettings.testBody: Huuliza Snippe kama ufunguo wako unafanya kazi. Hakuna pesa inayosogezwa.

webhook.title: Webhook ya Snippe
webhook.intro: Ongeza anwani hii kwenye dashibodi ya Snippe kama webhook ya matukio ya malipo (payment.completed, payment.failed, payment.expired, payment.voided). Bila hiyo malipo hayatathibitishwa.
webhook.missing: Seva haina anwani yake ya umma (API_PUBLIC_URL), kwa hivyo Snippe haina pa kutuma matokeo.

settings.title: Settings
settings.noPermission: Only admin staff can open the settings.

branding.title: Business branding
branding.intro: The name, logo, colours and fonts used across the site, the organiser console and the checkout. Changes reach every visitor within a minute.
branding.noPermission: Only admin staff can change the branding.
branding.sourceDefault: Nothing saved yet; the default brand is in use.
branding.taglineHint: Optional. Shown under the name on the checkout.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: SVG (recommended), PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 200 KB.
logo.svgNote: SVG files are checked: scripts, external links and event handlers are rejected.
logo.removeBody: The built-in logo is used in its place.

reasons.too_large: The file is larger than 200 KB.
reasons.not_svg: This is not a valid SVG file.
reasons.doctype: DOCTYPE and ENTITY declarations are not allowed.
reasons.forbidden_element: Scripts, embedded pages and animations are not allowed.
reasons.event_handler: Event handlers such as onclick are not allowed.
reasons.external_reference: The SVG links to something outside the file.
reasons.no_size: The SVG needs a viewBox (or a width and height).
reasons.type_mismatch: The file is not the image type it claims to be.
reasons.bad_type: The logo must be SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP.
reasons.unreadable: The file could not be read.

logo.builtin: No logo saved yet, so the built-in logo is used everywhere. Upload yours to replace it.

colours.title: Colours
colours.hint: The primary colour is used for buttons and headings; text on it is chosen automatically (white or near-black).

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.note: These fonts are already on the guest's device, so nothing is downloaded and nothing slows the page.

importEnv.title: Move from the server environment
importEnv.body: Copy the SMS and WhatsApp keys set in the server's variables into the saved settings here, stored encrypted. Settings you already saved are left alone.
importEnv.nothing: Nothing to move: every route is already saved, or has no settings on the server.
importEnv.after: After moving, you can delete the NEXTSMS_*, SMS_SENDER_ID and WHATSAPP_* variables on the server; the saved settings keep working.

paymentSettings.title: Payments
paymentSettings.intro: The mobile-money gateway for guest contributions. Changes apply immediately, without restarting the server.
paymentSettings.noPermission: Only admin staff can change the payment settings.
paymentSettings.fakeWarning: No real payments will be taken with this provider. Guests cannot pay by phone.

source.environment: Nothing saved yet; the server's variables are in use.

fieldHint.apiKey: Starts with snp_. From the Snippe dashboard.
fieldHint.webhookSigningKey: Shown once when you create the webhook in Snippe.
fieldHint.environment: Use sandbox to test without real money.
fieldHint.receiptEmail: Snippe needs a payer email. Guests are not asked for one, so this stands in.

paymentSettings.secretSaved: Saved: {hint}. Leave empty to keep using it.
paymentSettings.secretNew: It will not be shown again after saving.
paymentSettings.resetTitle: Go back to the server environment?
paymentSettings.resetBody: The saved settings are deleted. The server uses its own variables (test mode) until you save again.
paymentSettings.testBody: Asks Snippe whether your key works. No money moves.

webhook.title: Snippe webhook
webhook.intro: Add this address in the Snippe dashboard as the webhook for payment events (payment.completed, payment.failed, payment.expired, payment.voided). Without it, payments are never confirmed.
webhook.missing: The server has no public address of its own (API_PUBLIC_URL), so Snippe has nowhere to send results.
